name: Action1 Ticketing Connector
description: Prepare Action1 security and operational signals for ticketing integrations.

actions.label: List Organization Destination Mappings
actions.description: Loads Action1 organization to destination mappings from Ticketing-owned storage.

actions.label: Save Organization Destination Mapping
actions.description: Creates or updates an Action1 organization to destination mapping row.

actions.label: Delete Organization Destination Mapping
actions.description: Deletes an Action1 organization to destination mapping row.

actions.label: Discover Action1 Mapping Options
actions.description: Loads read-only Action1 organization options for the Mapping screen.

actions.label: Discover Destination Options
actions.description: Loads read-only destination options for the Mapping screen.

actions.label: Preview Mapping Auto Match
actions.description: Builds a read-only exact-name preview of unmapped Action1 organizations and active-provider customers.

actions.label: Apply Confirmed Mapping Matches
actions.description: Revalidates and creates only explicitly confirmed exact-name mappings through existing mapping storage.

actions.label: Discover Destination Routing Options
actions.description: Loads read-only destination routing options for configuration.

actions.label: Validate Configuration
actions.description: Validates Action1 Ticketing connectivity and required configuration.

actions.label: Save Ticketing Settings
actions.description: Validates and saves common and viewed-provider settings through the integration ownership boundary.

actions.label: Make Ticketing System Active
actions.description: Changes the active ticketing system without starting synchronization.

actions.label: Sync
actions.description: Collects Action1 signals and synchronizes Action1 Ticketing tickets.
